summary.result: If there is a flood flow through the gate, the highest water levels in front of the estuary dike are reduced 5~2Ocm depending on the frequency of flood compared with those before the project.
summary.background: The topographic influences for the hydraulic characteristics in the estuary were studied by the hydraulic model test.
summary.method: The geometrical model scales in horizontal and vertical are 1/300 and 1/100 respectively so that the distorted ratio is 3.
